purpose: Canonical worldwide directory of public traditional Latin Catholic liturgies with provenance-aware venue, ministry, liturgy, communion, schedule, source, and verification records.
invariants: A physical venue is not an ecclesial affiliation.
Communion and una-cum attributes attach to a ministry or celebration, never blindly to a venue.
Canonical/ecclesial status is represented by dated source assertions, not one timeless scalar.
UNKNOWN and VARIES are valid values; uncertain facts must not be forced to YES or NO.
Contentious communion or ecclesial classifications require explicit evidence source ids.
Schedules require provenance and a last-verified or upstream-updated timestamp when available.
Importers must preserve upstream identifiers and relationship classifications before canonical normalization.
Entity resolution may propose merges; it must not merge distinct houses, churches, chapels, or missions merely because they share clergy, community, city, telephone, or property.

releaseGates.venueIdentity: Every published venue needs a stable id, country, and either usable coordinates or a usable address.
releaseGates.provenance: Every schedule and contentious classification needs source provenance.
releaseGates.uniqueness: Upstream source identifiers may not map silently to multiple canonical venues.
releaseGates.safeMerging: Importers may not silently merge probable duplicates.
releaseGates.uncertainty: UNKNOWN and VARIES must survive normalization.
